title: Helldivers 2 Stratagems
description: The Stratagems Plugin brings the devastating power of Super Earth's orbital arsenal from Helldivers 2 into Minecraft.
body:
🚀 Stratagems Plugin 🌍✨

Bring the devastating power of Super Earth’s orbital arsenal from Helldivers 2 straight into Minecraft! Ordinary snowballs become stratagem beacons, calling down spectacular orbital strikes and support weapons — all with immersive delays and effects.

⚔️ Available Stratagems & Recipes

---

⚡ Orbital Precision Strike

🔧 Recipe: 1 Snowball + 1 TNT Block

💥 Effect: After a 3s delay, a colossal space cannon fires, delivering an explosion equal to 3x TNT power

---

🔥 Eagle Napalm Airstrike

🔧 Recipe: 1 Fire Charge + 1 TNT Block

🔥 Effect: Eagle swoops in, dropping napalm canisters in a line, leaving behind searing flames after 2s

---

💣 Eagle 500KG Bomb

🔧 Recipe: 2 TNT + 1 Gunpowder

💣 Effect: A bunker-busting mega-bomb embeds before detonating, carving craters after 3.5s

---


🛡️ Gatling Sentry

🔧 Recipe: 1 Dispenser + 1 Iron Block + 1 Redstone Torch + 1 Gunpowder

🛡️ Effect: A drop pod delivers an autonomous turret that tracks & shreds mobs within 24 blocks until its 480-round magazine is empty

---


💥 120MM HE Barrage

🔧 Recipe: 1 TNT + 1 Iron Ingot + 2 Gunpowder

💥 Effect: A sustained artillery strike, raining explosive shells across a wide area for 4 seconds

---

✨ Key Features

🎯 Authentic Helldivers 2 feel with targeting beams & timed delays

🌌 Orbital & aerial strikes with cinematic effects

💥 Explosions, particles & terrain regeneration for smooth gameplay

❄️ Crafted stratagems appear as enhanced snowballs with custom names & descriptions

⚡ Perfect for servers wanting tactical combat + visual spectacle, while staying balanced with realistic cooldowns & delays.
